text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Why? I satisfied all the
conditions.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Did I time my last spurt incorrectly? Or
was my pacing off? Maybe I
underestimated the winner,
or Parcae's
settings were wrong...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No, there's no point speculating now. I
can
analyze all that later. Right now, I
have to run the
numbers again.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Air Shakur left already?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No way! She never even looked over
here...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is she sulking just because she lost?
Wow, the
rumors were right. She really is
a total diva.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to Parcae's calculations, her
loss here means Air Shakur is not on her
optimal route. She
must've run off to
check her data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurry after Air Shakur and find her
hunched
quietly over her computer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What could've affected the results?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The answer's changed yet again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The seven-centimeter gap has shrunk
down to
three.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've recalculated the numbers twice
already, but
the answer hasn't budged.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what the catalyst for the change
was, but
that doesn't change the fact
that the numbers
have changed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just three more centimeters... Just three more measly centimeters... If I can get this down to zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. Look at me, gettin' all carried
away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This only means the numbers for the
optimal
route have decreased. If I can't
get it down to
zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then it's still the end of the road.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First, I gotta hit the target numbers
that'll have me lose by seven
centimeters, then I have to find the
variable that'll shrink that gap to
zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Go on back without me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur leaves before I can get in a
word. She probably wants to work
somewhere quiet. Meanwhile, a nearby
conversation catches my
attention.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that just now? I guess that's
how she
always is... totally full of herself.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is she even upset that she lost? I dunno
if I can
cheer for someone like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Closing this seven-centimeter gap'll
snuff out
the noise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain Air Shakur will perform
spectacularly at the Japanese Derby.
And when that happens,
I'm sure
everyone's opinion on her will change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she can win some big races,
the fans
will come around.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are things really changing?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I don't get those crappy nightmares
anymore.
That's all over—it's a new start
from here on
out...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I've only got three centimeters to go. If
I can just
shrink that down to zero...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But what if three centimeters is the
closest I'll
ever get?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if all this does is delay the
inevitable and
make me get my hopes
up for nothin'?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Rrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No... I'm being ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Think. Think! Rack your brain for an answer. The goddess of victory still eludes me, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes to chase her
down!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just you wait for the Japanese Derby!
